name: What are common signs that my bathroom faucet needs repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my bathroom faucet needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs that your bathroom faucet needs repair include drips or leaks, reduced water pressure, unusual noises, or difficulty turning the handles. Persistent leaks, even small ones, can lead to increased water bills and potential water damage over time. Addressing these issues promptly can prevent more extensive damage to your plumbing system. For CG Plumbing Solutions, our technicians often find that mineral buildup, especially in areas like Las Vegas with hard water, is a frequent cause of faucet problems requiring specialized cleaning or part replacement.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for drips, low pressure, strange noises, or stiff handles. Timely repair prevents water damage and higher bills.
